physics.criterion: Each physical rod, strand, and attached rigid body retains its own initial mass. Errors on separate bodies must not cancel in a combined total.
Every evaluated material interval preserves its reference arc length. Changing the rod shape, coil pitch, or endpoint span must not be achieved by stretching its material.
Over each adjacent output interval, each physical body linear momentum change equals its external force integral plus recorded external impulses.
Over each adjacent output interval, each physical body angular momentum change equals the external torque integral plus recorded external angular impulses about the same fixed world origin.
